text:
incident-bot: URGENT: High error rate and latency on inference-pool-uswest (GPU pool) — automatically paging oncall.

alex.m: got the page, looking. seeing a bunch of 503s in the hosted API dashboard, latency jumping to 12s p95.

maria.g: I'm on logs, queue depth for the gpu-inference queue spiked from ~800 to 18k in last 10m. :grimacing: 

dinesh.r: HPA events look weird — scale events fired but pods are Pending. K8s shows node allocatable GPU exhausted in us-west1.

kevin.l: Customer impact: a handful of power users reported timeouts on chat endpoints. Turning on incident tag and notifying CS.

alex.m: Mitigation idea: divert new traffic to us-east1 pools and put us-west1 into readonly. Can someone run temporary routing override?

sarah.s: I can flip region routing, but we need to ensure compatibility for model versions — quick check: us-east has same model variants for most customers.

ops-bot: Command: /route-override add region=us-east1 percentage=40 reason="emergency overflow" — initiated by sarah.s

maria.g: Logs: found frequent warmup failures on new pods: warmup-seq timeout 90s, retries thrashing. Error dump:
`````
[2026-02-12T14:18:32Z] warmup: model load failed: cudaMalloc returned out of memory
[2026-02-12T14:18:33Z] vm: OOM when initializing KV cache
`````

kevin.l: That suggests GPU nodes are accepting pods but OOM during model load — maybe node memory fragmentation or multiple large models per node.

dinesh.r: K8s node capacity: 0 available GPUs in the us-west1-gpu-pool, pods Pending due to "InsufficientGPU". HPA tried to create nodes but cloud autoscaler stuck in backoff.

alex.m: Queue backlog numbers from tracing: pre-inference queue depth by route:
- /v1/chat/completions: 12.3k
- /v1/generate: 4.1k
Average wait time before worker claim: 28s.

maria.g: Also seeing continuous OOM eviction events for kubelet on some nodes — suspect drivers crashed and kernel dropped GPUs.

kevin.l: Customer impact severity: HIGH for interactive apps (timeouts). CS pinged major customers and posted notice in status page (partial degradations).

sarah.s: Live mitigation steps I completed: 1) Enabled route-override 40% to us-east1; 2) Disabled new deploys to us-west1; 3) Scaled down non-critical workloads in us-west1 to free GPUs (batch jobs paused).

ops-bot: autoscaler: attempted scale up to 10 nodes, last error: "quotaExceeded: CPU quota reached for project" — cloud provider refused more instances.

dinesh.r: So autoscaler couldn't provision nodes because of VM quota; HPA still trying, pods Pending, queue grows — warmup errors from overcommitted pods causing OOMs.

alex.m: Hypothesis tracker (thread):
- H1: Cloud VM quota prevented autoscaler from adding nodes -> pool saturation -> queue backlog -> warmup thrash -> higher latency/503s.
- H2: A bad model snapshot increased per-pod memory footprint causing OOMs irrespective of nodes.
- H3: HPA tuning too aggressive with scaleDown cooldowns causing instability.

maria.g: Evidence for H1: cloud API shows repeated quotaExceeded errors at 14:19:05; autoscaler backoff timestamps align with queue spike.

maria.g: Evidence for H2: model size diff for the new variant shows +2.4GB in checkpoint compared to previous stable; but most pods use older variant.

kevin.l: Evidence for H3: HPA spec shows scaleDown stabilizationWindowSeconds=300 and scaleUp cooldown 60s; not ideal for sudden burst.

alex.m: Forensics: adding timeline snippet (rough):
- 14:12:00 — normal
- 14:15:30 — traffic increases (customer batch) and small spike
- 14:17:40 — HPA triggers scaleUp
- 14:18:00 — cloud autoscaler quotaExceeded
- 14:18:30 — queue depth starts exponential growth
- 14:19:05 — first warmup OOM on new pods
- 14:20:10 — incident-bot page triggered
- 14:21:00 — route override to us-east1
- 14:23:00 — partial recovery on routed traffic

sarah.s: Can someone post the exact HPA and autoscaler logs? I pulled kube events but need the cloud error traces.

maria.g: Pasting autoscaler snippet:
`````
I0212 14:18:02 autoscaler.go: Attempted to grow: 5 -> 10 nodes
E0212 14:18:03 cloud.go: error: quotaExceeded: "Project cpu quota exceeded"
I0212 14:18:55 autoscaler.go: Backoff for 2m
`````

alex.m: And pod events for a sample pending pod:
`````
Events:
  14:17:59 PodScheduled but no nodes available
  14:18:32 FailedAttachVolume: attach failed for gpu-driver
  14:19:05 Failed to create container: OOM during model load
`````

kevin.l: Who owns VM quotas? @maria.g you have access to request quota increases; can we get a temporary bump? If not, spin extra capacity in alternate region.

maria.g: I'm on quota request, but cloud support takes 30-60m. For immediate relief I recommend: 1) route more traffic to us-east1 (already partial), 2) cold-start throttle: reject requests that would trigger model warmup for large variants by returning 429/Retry-After for non-logged-in or low-tier customers.

dinesh.r: Implementing quick hotfix: set routing rule to prefer GPU pools with warmed model caches and gate new model loads under a token bucket.

alex.m: Also propose a post-incident change: reserve minReplicas=2 for critical pools so HPA doesn't shrink to 0 — current config has minReplicas=0 for some auto pools.

sarah.s: Agreed. Add to action items: quota escalation, minReplicas change, warmup backpressure, HPA tuning, alerting for "autoscaler quotaExceeded".

ops-bot: Action item logged: INCIDENT-1797532468: {"owner":"dinesh.r","task":"minReplicas config change","eta":"tomorrow 10:00"}

kevin.l: For RCA doc prep: we need sanitized logs (customer IDs removed) and timeline + hypothesis votes. Who will draft initial RCA outline?

maria.g: I'll start the timeline and collect logs. alex.m can do metric graphs (queue, p95 latency, HPA events). dinesh.r you do infra root cause (quota + warmup interplay).

alex.m: Taking metrics. Quick note: even after routing 60% to us-east1 the overall p95 for remaining us-west1 traffic is still high — indicates remaining pods are overloaded.

sarah.s: Handoff: I need to step out in 20m, who will be oncall lead? @dinesh.r can you take lead for next 2 hours?

dinesh.r: I can. Taking lead — remind me to follow up on quota request and verify that route overrides fully drain the backlog.

incident-bot: Handoff noted: oncall_lead -> dinesh.r at 14:25:00. Next update due in 15m.

kevin.l: Customer comms: CS posted update to major customers and status page. Please add link to RCAs once available.

alex.m: Quick mitigation status check: queue depth down to 9.2k (from 18k) after routing; p95 down from 12s to 7.1s for overall.

maria.g: Still seeing warmup OOMs at lower rate; likely will persist until we either increase node capacity or prevent model loads.

kevin.l: Ok. we're in mitigation mode. Keep thread as primary coordination channel. We'll compile the RCA after stabilization. Thx everyone.

sarah.s: Thanks all. Leaving notes in the incident doc and assigning follow-ups.
